command: set -eu; command -v adb; adb start-server >/dev/null; adb devices -l; SERIALS=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}'); COUNT=$(printf '%s\n' "$SERIALS" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l | tr -d ' '); test "$COUNT" = "1"; SERIAL=$(printf '%s\n' "$SERIALS" | head -n1); MANUFACTURER=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.product.manufacturer | tr -d '\r'); MODEL=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r'); echo SERIAL=$SERIAL MANUFACTURER=$MANUFACTURER MODEL=$MODEL; case "$MANUFACTURER" in samsung|Samsung) ;; *) exit 1;; esac; case "$MODEL" in SM-S906*) ;; *) exit 1;; esac
